[quote=the_crystalline_empire;60401614][b]The Treaty of the Bobian State[/b]

Following the formation of the Holy Orthodox Empire of Thýven, Emperor Piter Drømm would seek to begin the process of gradually stabilisng both his countries and the overall temperature of Elseyr as a continent. Turning to the first of the issues in the region, he'd quietly offer the Bobian state an opportunity to join the empire as an autonomous confederal state, with full independence in its economic. political and international affairs, but with direct military guarantees from the state and the potential for seats within the Chamber of Electors, thereby allowing representatives from the Bobian state direct say in whom the Emperor of Thýven was upon the convocation of a Special Electoral Session. The offer would be known as the Treaty of the Bobian State for the Continued Cooperation and Stability of Elseyr. 

[nation]BR Bob[/nation][/quote]
To Emperor Piter Drømm,

The Commonwealth of Bob formally declines this treaty.

Reason One: The last empire that claimed dominion over us gifted us famine, enslavement, genocide, and theft of our resources. The people of Bob will not ever accept subjugation, no matter how it is framed. Our independence is absolute and non-negotiable.

Reason Two: Your proposal referred to the commonwealth of Bob as the first of the issues in the region. We reject entirely the idea that our nation is an issue requiring resolution. This kind of language is insulting, unacceptable, and will never be tolerated by any Bobian citizen.

BR Bob will remain committed to cooperation, peace and partnership within THEP but we will never exchange our sovereignty for the shadow of an empire.

Yours sincerely
King Bob III

OOC: you really asked a country that literally went through centuries of being a part of the Hydronic empire to be in your empire first like genius move man 😭

[quote=nordiheim;60384065][b][u]The issue of the 3 tribes[/u][/b]
While support to the 3 tribes in the north-western part of Astanir would not stop their inability to work trough their differences and old grudges would be cause for concern, if they could not manage to work as a unified front then their strugle for freedom or atleast a bether tomorrow would only meat defeat ageinst their larger oponents.
As such two tings would need to be done:
*Find out as much as possible about their past grievances and points of disagreements
*And find a compromice they could all agree on.
They would also update them on the wider situation;

They would first be told about the good tings such as their Argossian brethren on the two lower islands was successfully rising up to claiming their freedom, and how the central enclave of the Sui-mana tribe were finaly reciving aid to be able to fight more propperly.

But they would then be struck with the bad news;
>How the Armed Restoration Front had a major stronghold on the large south-western island were they still had plenty of supplies and strenght that could be sendt to bolster their strenght on mainland Astanir ones more.
>The increasing controll and will to fight that the Astaniran National Forces was showing despite their battles.
>The supricing but effective attack on the Amaralo People's Army by the large nation of Pantagruel, wich not only left this faction under the controll of this large nation but also showed how far and with how much force they were potentialy ready and willing to go into Astanir with.
>And of corse the fact that the Democratic Army of Astanir had not only been taken over be another outside force, the Qianxun, but they had been reciving large amount of support and even troops to fight for their cause.

The Nordiheimians would emphatize with greate care the fact that the Argossian tribes would stand absolutely no chance to achive their freedom and goals if they could not find some way to look past their differences and work out a compromize that they could live with in an effort to work together as one force.

[b][u]The lower islands:[/u][/b]
When the tribes of Skui started their revolt on the secound island the Nordiheimians would use their agents on the island to direct and help the tribes to take a port so that propper amounts of weapons and supplies could be delivered to them.
Ones more the Nordiheimians would try to use the delivery of Iron Drake 2D tanks to bolster the Argossians with firepower that the local Armed Restoration Front forces would be hard pressed to deal with.
In addition a small attachment of Nordiheim navy vesels would be sendt to effectivly cut the small islands of from possible support.

[b][u]The Sui-mana:[/u][/b]
With the success of operation Sky Serpent efforts would be made to see if heavier weapons and light vehicles could be air dropped to them, this would start with weapons such as the 105mm artillery piece and larger mortar launchers together with amunition aswell as some lighter variants of the Kangaroo MAMIV to see how able the Sui-mana was at reciving and using them.
Nordiheim would have to wait for messages from their agents to find out how successfull it would be.

The agents in the sorounding lands controlled by the Astaniran National Forces would continue to look out for potential treaths to the large planes doing the air drops and communicate and new information they might gather, tough since the National forces now knew that someone was hidding there they would have to be more carefull about it and use some of their efforts on countering and dealing with atempts that might be done to find and stopping them.

[u][b]The large Astanir island joust south-east of Italian dutch:[/b][/u]
While the agents that had been dispatched there would continue their operatons of information gathering and infiltration the discovery that the Armed Restoration Front had such a stronghold there would have to be dealt with somehow.
As such a dedicated COMINT (Communications Intelligence) ship based in Ostland would be sendt to take up possition between the large island and Astanir itself to help intercept and listen inn on the cominications of the Armed Restoration Front, it would also try to listen inn on the Astaniran National Forces when they could.
It would be given a small dedicated navy escort to protect it, including Nordiheims 2 Sleipnir-Class Frigates incase the Restoration Front had any submarines up their sleeve.

[nation]United Hydronia[/nation] so its easier for you to see it :P
[nation]Shahzada[/nation] rp[/quote]

Despite the increasing stubbornness of the tribes towards each other, the Nordiheimian would be able to gather the following information:
[list]
- The four major tribes (including the Sui-mana) of the main island had all settled on the island separately hundreds of years earlier.
- They had all moved to Astanir to escape a phenomenon on the east Argossian mainland known as the great evil, yet nobody knows what this evil was, as it has since been lost to time.
- After settlement, several territorial issues arose which have stuck around to the modern day. During times of high tension, several wars even broke out between the tribes, along with already ongoing wars against the shamatine astanirans.
- The stories told by the different tribes had been all been bent in their individual favour over hundreds of years.
[/list]

Despite these issues, the good news brought by the Nordiheimians would be enough to temporarily rope the tribes back into negotiations. Additionally, the Sui-mana have requested that Nordiheim allow their representatives to attend negotiations too, by airlifting them out of the combat zone.

Additionally, the bad news would help empower the tribes to work together again, towards their common enemy.

On the lower islands, the multiple revolts would rapidly escalate and spread. Being cut off from their supplies by the Nordiheimians would cause the junta forces to be worn down quickly. Within a week, the entirety of the islands would be under the control of one Nordiheimian backed militia or another.

As operation sky serpent continued, the sui-mana would continue to push forward on all fronts. The heavier weapons provided would allow them to make a major offensive of the junta territory to the east of them, completely seizing multiple towns and strongholds. However, they wouldnt stop. As they continued to march on against the junta and the nationalists, they would also make an incursion into democratic territory, making no distinction between them and the other shamatine factions. This would be the biggest mistake of the war so far ([nation]Qianxun[/nation])

Whilst the Nordiheimians were undoubtedly providing a huge help to the argossians, they would not go unnoticed. The first hint would come to the restorationist/junta forces when Nordiheim made the decision to move ships into a prime supply route between the stronghold island and the main island. The high concentration of radar on the stronghold would detect a faint trace of the Nordiheimians, but wouldnt be powerfully enough to confirm, so when they sent the next supply run out, they would pack it full of radar in addition to submarine escorts which would survey from below. They would be careful to stay well away from the Nordiheimians, just enough to detect them. Upon receiving the data, the stronghold island would begin preparing a task force to confront the Nordiheimians.

In addition to this, battle reports from the Sui-mana enclave and the lower islands would reveal a clear picture to the junta forces. Nordiheim must be stopped.

[quote=sikirsk;60372130][b]Sikirsk State News, Evening Broadcast[/b]

[i]Good evening, citizens of the Federatsiya.
[/i]
Today, grave and unsettling news reaches us from the far northern reaches of the [b]Arctic[/b]. One of the [b]leading researchers and expedition leaders[/b] of the [nation]Sikirskian Colonial Administration[/nation], tasked with surveying new territories under the Grand Federations flag, [b]has gone missing under highly mysterious circumstances[/b]. Reports from the last transmission describe sudden disruptions in communication, unexplained environmental anomalies, and the abrupt silence of an otherwise disciplined team. Officials stress that there are no clear signs of hostile action, but the situation has cast a long shadow over the mission. A full-scale search operation is underway, though details remain [b][u]restricted[/u][/b] at this time.

In the homeland, the [b]Defense Ministry[/b] confirmed that additional long-range monitoring systems are being quietly activated along the Sikirskian Ocean perimeter. Though officials decline to link this to the Arctic disappearance, analysts note the timing as significant. Naval patrols have also been increased, and air-defense readiness has been elevated to a precautionary level.

Meanwhile, in the capital, attention briefly turned to the scientific community, where murmurs surrounding the governments experimental [b]Entity[/b] Program have resurfaced. While officials maintain that it remains a project for future technological development, its mention has added another layer of unease to an already tense atmosphere.

Thats it for now.

[i]Dobryden, Sikirsk![/i]

[b]===

[nation]United Hydronia[/nation][/quote]

News of Sikrisk's mysterious situation in their arctic territories were quickly brought forth to Hydronia's newly elected conservative government. President Seliban would approve the deployment of the SAB arctic special forces unit, more commonly known as the snow wolves, alongside a team of specialist arctic researchers to Sikirsk & their arctic territories to assist in the investigation of the mysterious happenings. This would be done through an order passed by the assembly on 28th January 2026. The unit would arrive at sikirsk by the 2nd February.

Additionally, a satellite would be diverted to view the arctic from above. The images would sent to the Hydronian arctic department, a constituent department of the ministry of environmental affairs, for inspection, before handing data over to the three administrative committees of the three unfederated arctic territories for experimentation and investigation. The details of the investigation are yet to be made public...

[b][u]Nordiheim international diplomatic announcement![/u][/b]

The Nordiheimian diplomatic team, led by Olian top diplomat Bakir al-Aydin, that was sendt to [nation]Sal-baliz[/nation] have retuned today with the great news that a Trade and Investment deal was negotiated and signed between our two nations.

This deal, called "The Phoenix Agreement", connects our two nations trough trade of goods, resources and services aswell as a large railroad project that is being initiated immidaitly by a quick decree from the council of Nordiheim.
The deal also negotiated forth a large investments into the railroad infrastructure and economy of Baliz, in return Nordiheim will be allowed a decent amount of shares and ownership in buisinesses, companies and corporations in Baliz within sensible reason.
Nordiheim will also take on a large share of creating a high capacity railroad from the Nordland region trough East Baliz and into Swabrahi to connect our two nations, it is said that it will be done using Nordiheimain steel but mostly local Baliz workers to improve the people there with much needed work and employment.

While it will cost a decent amount of capital, and the direct return on this investment will take some time to start propperly manifesting itself, it is belived by economical and finacial experts that a lot of this cost will be cushioned by the economic gain from the trade part of the deal, especialy as Balizs economy recovers and improves over the next year, both that of the corporat and civilian sector, as its economy is ripe for a high speed rise since it is being aided economicaly by several large and strong nations that have vested interest to stomp out any breeding ground for terrorists to appear there again aswell as ensure the legitimacy of King Ibrahim I Al-Baliz to improve stability in the country for the foreseeable future.

The full details of the deal can be found here:
[spoiler=[b]The Nordiheimian and Baliz Trade & Investment Agreement of 27th of January 2026 (Erene time)[/b]]
[b][u]The Phoenix Agreement[/u][/b]
[b]Trade and investment deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Shamatine Kingdom of Baliz[/b]
[i]====================================================[/i]

[i][u]With this agreement the two nations of Nordiheim and Baliz agree to adhere to the following agreements of trade:[/u][/i]
[i][u]_R__________E__________B__________I__________R__________T__________H_[/u][/i]

[b][i][u]Trade Deal Section[/u][/i][/b]
[u][b]1.a:[/b][/u] Both parties agree to open their civilian markets for free trade between each others nations to encourage the flow of goods, service and refined materials.

[u][b]1.b:[/b][/u] All trade are to be done in "good fait" and with fair prices based on world market prices on a quarterly basis.

[u][b]1.c:[/b][/u] If there should be a large change or upsett in the world economy the trade prices can be changed outside of the quarterly basis if both nations can agree.

[b][u]1.d:[/u][/b] Neither nation are allowed to place a tarif on any goods or service from the other nation that is higer then 10% unless the other nation fully agrees to it.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+Fire+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
[b][i][u]Resource Deal Section[/u][/i][/b]
[u][b]2.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim opens its resource market to Baliz for them to buy this resourses with currency of equal value.

[u][b]2.b:[/b][/u] Baliz opens its resource market to Nordiheim for them to buy these resourses with currency of equal value.

[u][b]2.c:[/b][/u] The Value of these resources will be based on world market prices that will be agreed on in quarterly intervalls together with the quantities of each resource.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+Hope+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++

[b][i][u]Railroad Section[/u][/i][/b]
[u][b]3.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim is willing to pay up to 70% of the cost of creating a large railroad trough the east Baliz land coridor connecting the two nations to make trade, transportation and buisiness between the two nations easier.

[b][u]3.b:[/u][/b] Nordiheim will also invest in the overall railroad infrastructer of Baliz in excange for % ownership in Baliz railroad companies current existing or being planed.

[b][u]3.c:[/u][/b] The ownership of these Baliz railroad companies can be had trough either the Nordiheimian state owned companies or private companies from Nordiheim.

[b][u]3.d:[/u][/b] The % ownership of any singular Baliz railroad company can not reach or exeed majority ownership of 51% in any combination of totality, and is capped at a maximum total of 40% Nordiheimian ownership trough any combination of state and private ownership.

[b][u]3.e:[/u][/b] Any railroad infrastructure created or repaired trough Nordiheimian investment will be fully owned by the Baliz state regardless of how much Nordiheim payed/invested.

++++++---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+Transformation+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
[b][i][u]Other Deals Section[/u][/i][/b]
[b][u]4.a:[/u][/b] Nordiheim will be allowed to invest in buisinesses, companies and corporations in Baliz in return for a % share in the companies.

[b][u]4.b:[/u][/b] The ownership of majorety share (51% or more) will not be allowed to be gained by Nordiheim or Nordiheimian companies/organizations, allowing them only a tottal ownership of 40% in any singular Baliz buisiness, company and corporation.

[b][u]5:[/u][/b] Nordiheim will allow Baliz and its companies and corporations access to its ports, in the Nordland region, for them to be able to have easier access to the world market for trading and buissines on the following terms:
a: Baliz must follow the same laws, rules and regulations as Nordiheimian users.
b: Baliz will pay a fee for the use of these ports and the infrastructer used to access them.
c: The fee must be reasonable and can not be higher then one that would have been levied towards a Nordiheimian user.
d: The fee will be negotiated and agreed upon on the same basis as it is with Nordiheimian user.
e: For the first 2 years a total of 25% of the fee will be paid by the nation of Nordiheim to help Baliz get tings up and going.

[b][u]6:[/u][/b] Both nations will be allowed to open embassies in each others national capitals.

[b][u]7:[/u][/b]  In the interest of cooperation Nordiheim declares a willingness to have the trade deal between them and Baliz be open to change and/or new amendments in the future should there be need for it because of changes in either nation or the world scene that have a noticable effect on the original intention of 'The Phoenix Agreement' as long as both parties can arive at a mutual agreement to such changes.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+Ashes+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
[b][u]Special Section:[/u][/b]
[b][u]8:[/u][/b] Nordiheim or Baliz will have the right to terminate this agreement if either nations do the following:
a: Deny access to purchases, or other items outlined to be available to each nation in this deal!
b: Send aid to, supply, or in any way support enemies of either nations such as terrorist groups, pirates, or nations either signatory is actively at war with!
c: Take or declare hostile action or intent against the other signatory of this agreement!
d: Hostile infringement on intelectual propperty owned by the other nation or its companies.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+Immortality+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++

[i]Signatory parties[/i]

[u][i]The Council of The United Regions of Nordiheim[/i][/u]---------------------------[u][i]His royal highness King Ibrahim I Al-Baliz of The Shamatine Kingdom of Baliz[/i][/u][/spoiler]

There are allready reports of Baliz citizens aplauding their new Kings ability to negotiate such a good deal for the nation and ensuring the creation of a new and bether future for them, though some remain sceptical wich is understandable considering their troubled and represive past.
International analyzers see this as very good sign for his approval rating and ability to keep the peace and stability of his nation, they also point to the fact that the diplomatic team being led by and made up of several Olians of the muslim faith most likely made it much easier to navigate the negotiations for both parties.

The Nordiheimian council is hopefull that this deal not only will be of great benefit of both nations but that it also could be a step in the right direction for better stability and safety in the southern regoin of east Shamat.
